title: Computational Measurement of Team-Process Phase Dynamics in Collaborative Virtual Reality
abstract: arXiv:2608.18660v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collaborative virtual reality (VR) environments make team communication observable as it unfolds, but conventional transcript analyses often summarize entire trials or divide them into fixed temporal windows. Such approaches can obscure changes in team communication and coordination over time. This article presents a computational framework for detecting and interpreting dynamic team-process phases from timestamped dialogue in a collaborative VR game. The framework uses late chunking to generate context-aware transcript representations, aggregates them into temporal chunks, and applies penalized Gaussian-kernel change-point detection to identify semantic transitions in team communication. After boundary detection, term frequency--inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), non-negative matrix factorization (NMF), and representative transcript segments provide structured evidence for phase interpretation. A locally deployed large language model

translated_title: 协作虚拟现实中团队过程阶段动态的计算测量
translated_abstract: 协作虚拟现实（VR）环境使团队沟通在展开时变得可观察，但传统的转录分析通常总结整个试验或将其划分为固定的时间窗口。此类方法可能掩盖团队沟通与协调随时间的变化。本文提出了一种计算框架，用于从协作VR游戏中的带时间戳对话中检测和解释动态团队过程阶段。该框架使用晚期分块生成上下文感知的转录表示，将其聚合为时间块，并应用惩罚高斯核变点检测来识别团队沟通中的语义转变。在边界检测后，词频-逆文档频率（TF-IDF）、非负矩阵分解（NMF）和代表性转录片段为阶段解释提供结构化证据。一个本地部署的大型语言模型进一步支持对每个检测到的阶段的定性描述。该框架通过一个涉及四名参与者完成协作任务的实证研究进行评估，展示了其揭示团队过程阶段动态演变的有效性，这些阶段与任务事件和团队互动模式相关联。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于计算方法的框架，利用时间戳对话和变点检测技术，在协作虚拟现实环境中动态识别和解释团队过程阶段，从而克服传统转录分析中固定时间窗口的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a computational framework that uses timestamped dialogue and change-point detection to dynamically identify and interpret team-process phases in collaborative virtual reality, overcoming the limitations of fixed temporal windows in traditional transcript analysis.
